entities.name: Eternal Night
entities.description: Event on Innistrad in which the sun vanished and the world was plunged into unending night through Olivia Voldaren's curse.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Vampire-dominated plane.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Ruthless vampire matriarch who seized the Moonsilver Key and engineered the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: Ancient artifact that bound the natural cycle of the moon and day.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Region whose vampire houses oppressed humans.

entities.name: Grigori
entities.description: A villager enduring the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: Battle-hardened knight leading the defenders.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Fiery planeswalker among the defenders.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: Wolf-shifter among the defenders.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Time mage among the defenders.

entities.name: Deidamia
entities.description: Witch among the defenders.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Ally who stormed the manor.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Ancient vampire elder, creator of Avacyn and reluctant guardian of humanity.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Now-lost angelic protector created by Sorin.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's missing grandfather, used as groom in Olivia's wedding.

entities.name: Voldaren Estate
entities.description: Olivia's stronghold.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: Ghostly witch spirit freed by the key's power.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Radiant angel long imprisoned by vampire magic.

entities.name: Celestus
entities.description: Site of the ritual that ended the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: Plane with eternal night before the Fusion.

entities.name: Diraden
entities.description: Plane with an eternal night lasting decades.

events.summary: Under endless night the vampire houses of Stensia tighten their grip on humans.
events.quote: the vampire houses of Stensia tightened their iron grip on the human population

events.summary: A ragtag alliance of defenders wages guerrilla warfare.
The defenders seek the aid of Sorin Markov, who returns to confront Olivia.
events.quote: the defenders sought the aid of

events.summary: Olivia seizes the Moonsilver Key, locking Innistrad into Eternal Night, and plans a political wedding using Edgar Markov.
Sorin infiltrates the Voldaren Estate and confronts Olivia and the spirit Katilda.
Sigarda is freed and her light shatters the stronghold's wards; allies storm the manor.
events.quote: The tide turned with the freeing of Sigarda

events.summary: Olivia flees, and the ritual at the Celestus with the restored key ends the Eternal Night.
events.quote: the vampire matriarch opted to flee rather than perish
